name: omnicollab
description: OmniCollab — Real-time collaborative workspace suite powered by Yjs, Monaco Editor, Socket.IO, Express, and Docker

scripts.copy:public: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('backend/public', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive:true}); console.log('Copied frontend build to backend/public successfully!')"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:public
